title: Closed Areas Regulation, Schedule 3, section 63 (Sea to Sky Highway)
heading: Sea to Sky Highway
sourceText:
Schedule 3 No Shooting or Hunting Areas (Section 4)
Sea to Sky Highway
63 That portion of the Province of British Columbia within 400 metres of the road allowance of Highway 99 between the northern boundary of the District of Squamish and the southern boundary of the Resort Municipality of Whistler. [en. B.C. Reg. 169/2020, App. 1, s. 1.]
sourceVersion: BC Laws consolidation current to October 13, 2026

quotes.geometry.from: the northern boundary of the District of Squamish
quotes.geometry.to: the southern boundary of the Resort Municipality of Whistler
quotes.geometry.side: within 400 metres of the road allowance

why: none of the places the section names was found in the official layers
validation failed: shape built (no shape could be built)

lookups.note: 2 separate roads named Highway 99 in the area
